_how_to_use: Each job is one block in the 'jobs' list. To add a job, copy a block, change the details, and set 'published' to true.
'closing' is the last day to apply (YYYY-MM-DD). The job disappears from the site automatically after that day. Leave it empty for no closing date.
To remove a job early, set 'published' to false or delete its block.
A job can have its own 'apply_url' (for example a Google Form for that role). It is used instead of 'apply_form_url' for that job only.
'apply_form_url' is the link to the application form (for example a Tally or Google Form). Leave it empty and the Apply button opens an email to the company instead.
After editing, run: python build.py   then commit and push. The live site updates in about a minute.

jobs.title: Facility & Operations Officer
jobs.summary: Support the day-to-day running of the properties we manage in the Ajah/Ogombo area, working with our field teams, clients and service providers, and help grow our client base.
responsibilities: Support the day-to-day supervision, inspection and maintenance of properties and facility operations.
Coordinate and follow up with cleaners, artisans, technicians and other service providers.
Prepare weekly and monthly operational reports and maintain property records.
Track maintenance issues, assigned tasks and outstanding actions.
Assist with client communication, inquiries, complaints and service follow-up.
Identify potential clients and properties within the target areas.
Conduct physical and online marketing activities to generate new leads.
requirements: OND or HND in any relevant discipline.
Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
Good organisational, administrative and record-keeping skills.
Must be proactive, responsible, teachable and willing to work in the field.
Must reside within or be able to easily commute to the Ajah/Ogombo axis.
Previous experience is not mandatory, but internship, NYSC, sales, customer service, property or facility management experience is an advantage.
